statement: Annotated from the Beinecke scan alone (canvas 1006233, the right-hand panel of the 88v/89r foldout: an overview, four horizontal strips and a close-up of the faint lower middle); no transcription word, no transcription comment and no other annotation of this folio was read. The panel is a pharmaceutical page in four registers, each with a footed, banded or striped jar in the left margin and a row of roots/plants to its right, the first three followed by a paragraph. Register 1: jar and four plants (forked red taproot, frilled tuft with two spiny round leaves, cloud-crowned bulb, long sinuous root with two flame leaves). Register 2: jar and two large horizontal roots. Register 3: jar and five small plants, plus one large red-brown tendrilled root at the right margin. Register 4: jar, a red club root with a two-lobed leaf, an elongated leaf on a stalk, a faint plant, and a round-leaved plant with a huge tan root. Label loci were taken only from the transcription's line ids and unit codes (@Lc container, @Lf plant), which fall into four groups: one container label then the plant labels of each register, read left to right. Each Lc is given to that register's jar (f89r2.29-30 is one two-line jar label, given as f89r2.29). The plant labels are paired with the plants they sit beside, left to right: 4, 2 and 5 labels match registers 1-3 exactly; the large right-margin root of register 3 has no label of its own. In register 4 four labels lie among four objects: f89r2.31 sits under the elongated leaf, f89r2.32 under the faint plant, and f89r2.33 and f89r2.34 flank the round leaf of plant 16, so f89r2.33 is left unassigned and plant 13 (the red club root) is given no label: an uncertain pairing.
